meta.title: Supermemory
meta.description: Gives the agent long-term memory on a Supermemory server (v5 API), in its own namespace, and recalls relevant facts before a turn and captures the finished session after it. Tools appear as supermemory_* in the Tools list and the agent is told about its memory in the system prompt; existing data stays on the server when the bundle is turned off, it just stops being recalled or written. Needs a Supermemory server and the SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY credential; processing is asynchronous, so a saved document becomes searchable after the server finishes it. Other agents' namespaces (such as Hermes) are never written; they are recalled as untrusted background only when listed in readContainers or matched by readPrefixes (both empty by default); subagents neither recall nor capture by default.
